verdict.rationale: monday.com ships AI agents, a developer MCP for scaffolding and promoting apps, and the monday vibe app builder, so asking whether an agent can visually verify what it built is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the pack shows an agent navigating the UI or capturing before-and-after screenshots to check its own work. The agent features documented are messaging, item assignment, board-scoped actions and auditing, none of which amount to visual self-verification.
